title: A Weekend in Curitiba
titlePt: Um Fim de Semana em Curitiba
summary: Two friends spend a simple weekend visiting parks and eating together.

paragraphs.pt: No sábado, Lucas visitou sua amiga Nanda em Curitiba. De manhã, eles caminharam no Jardim Botânico. O tempo estava fresco, e muitas famílias tiravam fotos perto das flores. Lucas queria mostrar que conhecia a cidade, mas logo percebeu que Nanda sabia caminhos melhores.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday, Lucas visited his friend Nanda in Curitiba. In the morning, they walked in the Botanical Garden. The weather was cool, and many families were taking pictures near the flowers. Lucas wanted to show that he knew the city, but soon realized that Nanda knew better routes.

paragraphs.pt: Depois, almoçaram em um restaurante pequeno. Lucas pediu frango com arroz, e Nanda escolheu massa. Quando a chuva começou, eles mudaram os planos. Em vez de ir ao parque, compraram ingredientes para fazer brigadeiro na casa de Nanda.
paragraphs.en: Afterward, they had lunch in a small restaurant. Lucas ordered chicken with rice, and Nanda chose pasta. When the rain began, they changed their plans. Instead of going to the park, they bought ingredients to make brigadeiro at Nanda's house.

paragraphs.pt: No domingo, o sol voltou por algumas horas. Eles caminharam na praça, conversaram sobre trabalho, filmes e férias, e riram da panela de brigadeiro que quase queimou. Lucas voltou para sua cidade feliz e descansado, com a sensação de que amizade boa não depende do clima.
paragraphs.en: On Sunday, the sun returned for a few hours. They walked in the square, talked about work, movies, and vacations, and laughed about the brigadeiro pan that almost burned. Lucas returned to his city happy and rested, with the feeling that good friendship does not depend on the weather.
